title: On Display at FLIBS: Sunseeker 90 Ocean Enclosed 2024 | WORTH THE WAIT
description: WORTH THE WAIT: 2024 Sunseeker 90 Ocean Enclosed, award-winning floating penthouse layout with enclosed flybridge, 4 cabins and beach club. On display at FLIBS 2025.
html:
View WORTH THE WAIT At FLIBS 2025 | October 29–November 2

WORTH THE WAIT is a 2024 Sunseeker 90 Ocean Enclosed, an 88.92 ft (27.1 m) yacht currently located in Miami, FL and scheduled for display at the Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show October 29–November 2. What distinguishes this example is the enclosed flybridge configuration with the “floating penthouse” concept that prioritizes interior volume and light; the model won the World Yacht Trophies 2023 award for Best Layout in the 80’–98′ category. With four guest cabins, an expansive beach club and contemporary interior architecture by Italian Design Unlimited, the boat reads as both a long-range cruiser—rated for roughly 1,800 nautical miles—and a platform for refined entertaining and relaxed coastal passages.

Enclosed-Flybridge 88.92ft Sunseeker: Miami Showcase

On show in Miami and featured at FLIBS, this enclosed-flybridge Sunseeker maximizes usable space while preserving the commanding sightlines and sheltered helm typical of flybridge craft; the design creates an elevated, protected social zone above the main deck while the floating penthouse increases headroom and interior volume below. Measured at 88.92 ft with a 6.42 ft draft, the yacht is suited to a wide range of cruising grounds—from shallow bays to extended offshore hops—yet remains easy to handle alongside a professional crew or experienced owner-operator.

Award-Winning Layout and Light-Filled Interior Design

Inside, the Italian Design Unlimited scheme emphasizes clean lines, abundant natural light and a contemporary palette that enhances the sense of space created by the floating penthouse. The four-cabin layout is organized for both privacy and sociability—guest accommodations are generous, circulation is fluid, and the main salon opens visually to the aft deck to create a true indoor–outdoor living experience. High-quality finishes and the forthcoming installation of new teak decks under warranty reinforce the yacht’s fresh-delivery condition.

Performance, Range and Upgrades: Speed to 26 Knots

Under power this Sunseeker produces cruise-capable performance with a top speed in the mid-20 knot range—approximately 26–27 knots depending on load and sea state—while offering an economical long-range capability of about 1,800 nautical miles for extended passages. Systems are covered by a transferable Passport Premier Extended Warranty through December 2028, which preserves major mechanical and electrical components and reduces operational uncertainty; new teak decking and factory-backed services further support long-term ownership satisfaction.

Expansive Decks, Massive Beach Club and Outdoor Living

Decks have been arranged to promote sociable, usable exterior spaces: the aft cockpit flows to a sizeable beach club that invites water-level lounging, boarding and watersports staging, while the enclosed flybridge provides a sheltered, versatile area for alfresco dining and navigation. The scale of the outdoor areas—plus thoughtful thought given to traffic flow between swim platform, cockpit and salon—makes the yacht equally capable for family weekends, entertaining friends, or staging longer cruising itineraries that include frequent embarkation from marinas and private coves.

Extended Warranty, Service Guard and Transferable Passport

A notable ownership advantage is the transferable Passport Premier Extended Warranty that covers all major systems through December 2028, supported by Service Guard protection for fabrics and finishes; these protections reduce maintenance exposure and preserve resale value during the initial years of ownership. Combined with the factory commitment to install new teak decks under warranty and the boat’s like-new 2024 delivery status, the package provides confidence to buyers who prioritize low initial upkeep and documented coverage.

Key Highlights Recap and Invitation to Discover More

WORTH THE WAIT pairs an award-winning enclosed-flybridge Sunseeker layout with a floating-penthouse interior, four cabins, a substantial beach club, new-teak-deck warranty work and a manufacturer-backed extended warranty—while delivering roughly 1,800 nm range and top speeds around 26–27 knots. Displayed this season in Miami and at the Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show (Oct 29–Nov 2), she represents a strong choice for owners seeking generous interior volume, extensive outdoor living and long-range capability.
